rule: Historical records remain byte-for-byte unchanged. Resolve campaign inventories against their original capture directory or historical configuration overlay, never against the current configuration by default.
evidence_SHA256SUMS: Paths are relative to the directory containing each inventory.
historical_config_locks: Paths beginning configs/ resolve to the same-named file beside the historical lock when present; other config dependencies fall back to current configs/. This reconstructs the retained historical configuration overlay.
validated_code_inventory: provenance/R3_VALIDATED_CODE_SHA256SUMS.txt paths are relative to repository root.
baseline_source_manifests: baseline_source entries resolve against baseline/pre_hardening/. Frozen implementation and harness entries use their snapshot root, falling back to repository-root files only when absent from the overlay.
preservation_JSON_inventories: files and *_all_file_hashes are relative to the named evidence/simulated_smoke/MP005_SIMULATED_SMOKE_R1, R2 or R3 session.
administrative_inventory_exclusions: Obsolete whole-workspace/prompt packet inventories are excluded rather than edited. Original bytes and per-file reasons are preserved in the separate audit deliverables and unchanged source collection.
